org_configured.description: True once organization-specific authority weights and review SLAs are bound.

organization_name.description: Display name of the tenant organization.

stale_review_days.description: Days after last_reviewed_at before a policy or SOP is flagged stale.

recency_half_life_days.description: Exponential decay half-life in days when ranking document freshness.

duplicate_title_similarity_threshold.description: SequenceMatcher title similarity ratio triggering near-duplicate review.

min_citation_coverage_pct.description: Required percentage of synthesized claims backed by verified source IDs.

allow_draft_versions_in_answers.description: Whether unpublished draft SOP versions (e.g. SharePoint minor 1.2) may be cited as authoritative.
